sources.title: DeepSeek 据报道接近完成至少 800 亿元融资，腾讯与宁德时代参与 / DeepSeek is close to raising at least 80 billion yuan ($12 billion), up from its original target of about 50 billion yuan, Bloomberg repo...

sources.title_original: DeepSeek is close to raising at least 80 billion yuan ($12 billion), up from its original target of about 50 billion yuan, Bloomberg repo...
sources.summary: 据 Bloomberg 援引知情人士报道，DeepSeek 接近完成至少 800 亿元（约 120 亿美元）融资，高于原定约 500 亿元的目标。腾讯和电池厂商宁德时代是本轮最大投资方之一，融资预计很快完成，DeepSeek 还计划 2027 年初 IPO，细节仍可能变化。
